cards.ex: The housing shortage is driving up rental prices in the city center.
cards.exUz: Uy-joy yetishmasligi shahar markazida ijara narxlarini oshirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Uy-joylar talabga nisbatan kam bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: Walking through the skyscraper canyons, I felt dwarfed by the massive buildings.
cards.exUz: Osmono'par qoyalar orasidan yurib, men o'zimni ulkan binolar oldida kichik his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Osmono'par binolar orasidagi tor ko'chalar.

cards.ex: Property prices in the commuter belt have risen sharply.
cards.exUz: Qatma mintaqada mulk narxlari keskin oshdi.
cards.uzDef: Shahar atrofidagi, odamlar ishga qatnaydigan hudud.

cards.ex: The government is trying to tackle urban blight with new investment.
cards.exUz: Hukumat yangi investitsiyalar bilan shahar tanazzuliga qarshi kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Shahar hududining iqtisodiy va fizik jihatdan yomonlashuvi.

cards.ex: The inner city is struggling with high unemployment and crime.
cards.exUz: Shahar markazi yuqori ishsizlik va jinoyatchilik bilan kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning eski, odatda kambag'alroq qismi.

cards.ex: The developer was offered a density bonus for including affordable housing.
cards.exUz: Ishlab chiquvchiga arzon uy-joylar qo'shgani uchun zichlik bonusi taklif qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Qurilish loyihasida zichlikni oshirishga ruxsat berish.

cards.ex: The new office complex is a green building, designed to minimize its environmental impact.
cards.exUz: Yangi ofis majmuasi ekologik toza bino bo'lib, atrof-muhitga ta'sirini kamaytirish uchun mo'ljallangan.
cards.uzDef: Ekologik toza materiallardan qurilgan va energiya samarador bino.

cards.ex: There's a long waiting list for public housing in most cities.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina shaharlarda davlat uy-joyi uchun uzoq kutish ro'yxati mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Hukumat tomonidan kam ta'minlanganlar uchun taqdim etiladigan uy-joy.

cards.ex: The city needs more affordable housing to attract young professionals.
cards.exUz: Shaharga yosh mutaxassislarni jalb qilish uchun ko'proq arzon uy-joy kerak.
cards.uzDef: Aholi daromadiga mos keladigan uy-joy.

cards.ex: The historic district is protected by law to preserve its architectural heritage.
cards.exUz: Tarixiy tuman o'zining me'moriy merosini saqlab qolish uchun qonun bilan himoyalangan.
cards.uzDef: Tarixiy ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan hudud.

cards.ex: This residential area is quiet and peaceful, perfect for families.
cards.exUz: Bu turar joy hududi tinch va osoyishta, oilalar uchun ideal.
cards.uzDef: Asosan turar joy binolaridan iborat hudud.

cards.ex: The commercial district is bustling with activity during the day.
cards.exUz: Savdo tumani kunduzi faollik bilan gavjum.
cards.uzDef: Asosan do'konlar, ofislar va bizneslardan iborat hudud.

cards.ex: The industrial zone is located on the outskirts of the city.
cards.exUz: Sanoat zonasi shahar chekkasida joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Sanoat korxonalari joylashgan hudud.

cards.ex: High-density housing can help to reduce urban sprawl.
cards.exUz: Yuqori zichlikdagi uy-joy shahar kengayishini kamaytirishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik hududda ko'p sonli uy-joylar.

cards.ex: Low-density housing is common in suburban areas.
cards.exUz: Past zichlikdagi uy-joy shahar atroflarida keng tarqalgan.
cards.uzDef: Katta hududda kam sonli uy-joylar.

cards.ex: Mixed-use zoning encourages walkable neighborhoods.
cards.exUz: Aralash zonallashtirish piyoda yurish mumkin bo'lgan mahallalarni rag'batlantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil foydalanish maqsadlarini bir hududda birlashtirish.

cards.ex: Transit-oriented development reduces reliance on cars.
cards.exUz: Transportga yo'naltirilgan rivojlanish avtomobillarga bog'liqlikni kamaytiradi.
cards.uzDef: Jamoat transporti atrofida rivojlanish.

cards.ex: Effective urban planning is essential for a sustainable future.
cards.exUz: Samarali shaharsozlik barqaror kelajak uchun zarur.
cards.uzDef: Shaharlarni rejalashtirish va rivojlantirish jarayoni.

cards.ex: You need a building permit before you can start construction.
cards.exUz: Qurilishni boshlashdan oldin sizga qurilish ruxsatnomasi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qurilish ishlarini boshlash uchun zarur bo'lgan ruxsat.

cards.ex: Strict development control is in place to protect the environment.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish uchun qat'iy rivojlanish nazorati mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Qurilish va rivojlanishni tartibga soluvchi qoidalar.

cards.ex: The green belt prevents urban sprawl from encroaching on the countryside.
cards.exUz: Yashil belbog' shahar kengayishini qishloqqa kirib borishiga yo'l qo'ymaydi.
cards.uzDef: Shaharni o'rab turgan yashil hudud.

cards.ex: The ancient ruins are a protected heritage site.
cards.exUz: Qadimgi xarobalar himoyalangan meros obyekti hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Tarixiy yoki madaniy ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan joy.

cards.ex: The reclamation project transformed the polluted area into a park.
cards.exUz: Tiklash loyihasi ifloslangan hududni bog'ga aylantirdi.
cards.uzDef: Buzilgan yerlarni qayta tiklash loyihasi.

cards.ex: Urban regeneration can improve the quality of life for residents.
cards.exUz: Shahar qayta tiklanishi aholi uchun hayot sifatini yaxshilashi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning buzilgan hududlarini yaxshilash.

cards.ex: Infill development makes better use of existing infrastructure.
cards.exUz: Ichki rivojlanish mavjud infratuzilmadan yaxshiroq foydalanishga imkon beradi.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning bo'sh joylarida qurilish.

cards.ex: The setback requirements ensure that buildings are not too close to the street.
cards.exUz: Orqaga chekinish talablari binolarning ko'chaga juda yaqin bo'lmasligini ta'minlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qurilishning mulk chegarasidan qanchalik uzoqda bo'lishi kerakligi.

cards.ex: Brownfield redevelopment can create new opportunities for growth.
cards.exUz: Qo'ng'ir erlarni qayta rivojlantirish o'sish uchun yangi imkoniyatlar yaratishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ifloslangan yerlarni tozalash va qayta qurish.

cards.ex: The waterfront development has transformed the city's skyline.
cards.exUz: Sohilbo'yi rivojlanishi shahar manzarasini o'zgartirdi.
cards.uzDef: Suv bo'yidagi hududlarni rivojlantirish.

cards.ex: The urban heat island effect is exacerbated by lack of green space.
cards.exUz: Shahar issiqlik oroli effekti yashil maydonlarning etishmasligi bilan kuchayadi.
cards.uzDef: Shahar hududlarining qishloqqa nisbatan issiqroq bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The city continues to sprawl outwards, consuming farmland.
cards.exUz: Shahar tashqariga kengayishda davom etmoqda va qishloq xo'jaligi erlarini iste'mol qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Shahar hududining tashqi tomonga kengayishi.
